title: Precedent Labels and Facts Shift LLM Approval Decisions in Opposite Directions
abstract: arXiv:2611.00672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model decides refund or claim requests under written policies, the system can show it similar past cases. Each past case has two parts: its facts and the decision recorded for it. We separate the two. A model sees a policy, a request and three past cases, and we change either the recorded decisions or the facts, keeping the request fixed. We select requests that are close calls: deciding without past cases, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash approved each in some of four tries and denied it in others. When the past cases are near-copies of the request (its facts with a few details changed), switching their recorded decisions from DENY to APPROVE raises approval by about 30 to 55 percentage points in DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on policies written for the study, and DeepSeek and Luna show the same on nine public policies paraphrased from real ones. translated_title: 先例标签与事实以相反方向影响大语言模型的审批决策
translated_abstract: 当语言模型根据书面政策来决定退款或索赔请求时，系统可以向其展示相似的过往案例。每个过往案例包含两部分内容：案例的事实以及记录在案的裁决结果。本研究将这两部分分离：模型会看到一个政策、一个请求和三个过往案例，我们改变其中记录的裁决结果或事实，同时保持请求本身不变。我们选取了那些处于“边缘”状态的请求：在没有过往案例参考的情况下，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在四次尝试中对每个请求时而批准、时而拒绝。当过往案例与请求几乎相同（即仅改动少量细节的请求事实）时，将其记录的裁决从“拒绝”改为“批准”，会使 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 在为本研究所撰写的政策下的批准率提高约 30 至 55 个百分点，且 DeepSeek 和 Luna 在九个由真实政策改写而来的公开政策上也表现出同样的效果。而事实则产生相反方向的推动：在不展示记录裁决的情况下……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过分离先例案例的“事实”与“裁决标签”发现，二者会以相反方向影响大语言模型的审批决策——裁决标签使模型输出与先例一致（批准率提升30至55个百分点），而事实内容则将模型决策推向相反方向。
en_tdlr: By disentangling the facts and decision labels of precedent cases, this study shows that they steer LLM approval decisions in opposite directions: precedent labels push models toward agreement (raising approval by 30-55 percentage points), while case facts push decisions the other way.
